author: ojiudezue
title: EV flip-flop fixed by capping rung-1's solar credit, not by banning EV charging during arbitrage
summary: Rung 1 paused EVs on poor-forecast daylight off-peak ticks by crediting the car's whole draw as solar the battery could take; on 11-08 the cars ran on grid (solar 1-2 kW), so the pause freed nothing and the loop toggled 7x/charger in 30 min. Fix D credits only the EV draw not covered by fresh grid import and holds the latch until the rate window is post-pause.
why: Measured: no SOC band (episodes at 7-10% and 30%), the 80-90% chatter was fill_priority. A blanket 'no EV during arbitrage' would have blocked ~17.5 h/week of overnight charging (arbitrage active ~53 h/week) and added a standing pause owner; min-hold only slows the loop; the card's 'judge without the paused EV' already existed. Operator wanted overnight off-peak protected and no new machinery on hardened code.
alternatives_considered: Blanket EV pause while arbitrage active
Minimum hold time on the pause
Judge projection without the paused EV (already present)
implications: Rung 1 now rarely fires; a genuine solar-fed but battery-flat case can still cycle once per ~15 min. The duplicate SOC sampler (EC-ATTAIN-RATE-DUP-SAMPLE-1) makes the hold 1 tick in production.
revisit_trigger: EV toggle trip-wire fires on an arbitrage-owned off/on/off within 4 ticks, or a recorded daylight episode with fresh import < EV draw that still flaps.
